experience_work.title: Support Engineer Intern, Microsoft
description: ‣ Trained in Azure, Windows, Dynamics 365, and SharePoint support, solving technical customer cases with empathy-led troubleshooting.
‣ Won 1st. place at Microsoft Fix-a-thon (among 21,000+ nationwide participants), and later secured 1st place in Customer Story Presentations and 2nd place in Aspireathon among our cohort.

‣ Learned how strong technical systems and strong human support go hand in hand, shaping my love for collaborative problem-solving, thoughtful communication, and building tech that genuinely empowers people.

experience_work.title: Web Developer & QA Tester, 26ideas
description: ‣ As the only student at a fast-paced startup, built the company website from scratch using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and AJAX, developed an EdTech web app, and shipped 4 client-facing projects that solved real business needs.

‣ Worked across development and QA, owning projects end-to-end — from building responsive interfaces and backend to leading testing for Fixling, debugging critical issues, and mentoring a junior tester.
‣ Learned to thrive in ambiguity: turning loose requirements into working products, honing new technologies quickly.

experience_work.title: Content Writer, Kcreative Writing
description: ‣ Wrote professional content across diverse domains, including college reviews, product launches, project summaries, blogs, ratings, and brand comparisons for a global client base, primarily in the United States.
‣ Applied SEO, keyword strategy, and marketing techniques to optimize content performance and reach.

experience_leadership.title: 'Future Looks Like You' Future Accelerator Mentee, Untapped
description: ‣ Selected as 1 of 21 participants for the global Mentorship Accelerator, and the only participant chosen from outside the United States.
‣ Learned directly from LinkedIn creators and industry professionals through focused sessions on career growth in tech.
‣ Participated in small-group coaching and built meaningful connections within a global tech community.

experience_leadership.title: Creator Group Cohort, Qoom
description: ‣ Secured a place in the Qoom Creator Group cohort by winning RU Hacks 2021.
‣ Built LearnLily, an all-in-one education platform for students and job seekers, in a team of two.
‣ Developed an ML-powered speech analysis feature for LearnLily, to detect speaking posture, fumbling, and use of external aids; won the Audience Choice Award at the end of the cohort.
